title: Virasoro Constraints for Projective Complete Intersections
summary: We prove the Virasoro conjecture for the ordinary descendant Gromov–Witten theory of smooth complete intersections in projective space, in every genus and curve class and with arbitrary cohomology insertions. This includes primitive and odd cohomology classes, with no semisimplicity assumption.
family_title: Virasoro constraints for complete intersections and projective-bundle towers

review.reason: Proves the Virasoro conjecture for descendant Gromov–Witten theory of smooth complete intersections.
